name: leg_stretch
text: A person faces a park bench, places the left heel onto the 45cm-high seat with the left leg almost straight, keeps the right foot planted on the ground, and leans the torso forward to stretch toward the raised leg. Hold the stretch without stepping or sitting.

review.reason: 3帧全身约束，抬脚及手部局部接触约束；脚和两手目标最大误差均小于3.8厘米，首尾一致且无冻结。
review.known_limitations: SOMA77 单人源动作；未做运行时火柴人映射与场景接触验收。手指无独立抓取动画。
review.post_export_edits: 仅walk_brisk裁剪记录中的完整周期；其余NPZ保持生成输出原样。
review.constraint_source_note: 临时参考路径仅为来源记录；实际约束数值保存在constraint_targets。
